captions.predicted_vs_measured: 450 saved conditional comparisons. Color: B0/B0I; marker: S2/S4; filled/open: cosine/sine. Band is ±2% of measured RZ. Axes can overlap. No model was evaluated.
captions.relative_error_distribution: Signed saved-value error; 20 shared bins within each system. All points retained. Dashed ±2% boundaries use measured RZ. Counts are axes, not independent samples.
captions.error_vs_q: All saved axes by q, S2/S4 and system. Lines are unweighted method means pooled over saved prefixes/cosine/sine; no fit or causal q interpretation.
captions.error_vs_prefix: All saved axes by prefix, S2/S4 and system. Lines are unweighted method means pooled over saved q/cosine/sine; no fit or causal prefix interpretation.
